g.text: High-Performance Cloud Streaming Architecture • 100% Direct Play • Zero-Transcode Invariant
Heavy 4K stream flows directly from Cloud CDN to Client Player (0% Server Load)
• WireGuard Mesh: Exposes port 8096 on private tailnet (100.x.y.z)
• Tailscale Funnel: Public HTTPS on port 443 with automated Let's Encrypt
• Zero Host Pollution: Tunnel device /dev/net/tun stays 100% inside container
Guarantees 0% CPU Host Load — 4K Remux streams are never re-encoded
• Apple DTS Audio Remux: Repackages DTS ➔ AAC on-the-fly (<1% CPU)
Eliminates "Failed to load file" errors on iOS, macOS, and Apple TV
• Autonomous STRM Generator: Discovers TorBox torrents & fetches TMDb v3 metadata
• Multi-Version Disambiguation: Coexists 4K IMAX & 1080p SDR without file flapping
• Two-Way Persistence: Automatically remembers manual folder moves & [tmdbid] tags
• Anime & Regional Isolation: Heuristic classifier separates Bleach TYBW & Indian cinema
• DERP Keepalive Heartbeat: 60s probe pings public Funnel URL to auto-heal idle relays
Detects Docker Desktop UI reboots & automatically re-attaches orphaned network namespaces
Host never re-encodes video streams (0% CPU load)
Runs cool & whisper quiet on mini PCs or Raspberry Pi
DTS-HD/MA repacked to AAC on-the-fly (<1% CPU)
Zero playback failures on Apple TV, iOS, and macOS
Auto-reconnects broken netns on Docker UI reboots
DERP relay keepalives & 10-day TorBox cache refresh
